_note: Street closures: an EXTERNAL authoritative fact that overrides what the camera saw. A bay inside an active closure is not available parking, however empty it looks from 30 m. Matched by GEOMETRY, never by street name - `street` here is a human label only. See TODO #13.

_schema.id: stable string id; the closure's key in the DB and in the sidecar
_schema.street: display label for humans (Cyrillic, as in the bay data's mestopoloz)
_schema.reason: why it is closed - shown in the map popup
_schema.valid_to: ISO 8601, null = open-ended (no known end date)
_schema.source: who says so - the authority this was taken from
